source.name: NASA MODIS Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Monthly L3 Global 0.05 Degree CMG V061
source.annualization_note: A grid-cell value has full-year coverage only when earth_months_observed is 12.
source.input_note: Monthly MODIS day/night LST values were quality filtered, averaged by channel, then averaged across available months per grid cell.

matching.temperature_match_percentage: 100 × min(lunar K, Earth K) / max(lunar K, Earth K)
matching.interpretation: 100 means equal temperatures; lower percentages indicate a larger relative difference. This is a similarity score, not a probability.
limitations: Earth values are clear-sky satellite surface temperatures; lunar inputs are modeled annual averages 2 cm below the surface.
The provided MODIS grid contains monthly composites. With fewer than 12 months, the Earth value is a partial-year mean, not an annual mean.
The monthly composites use mandatory good-quality MODIS QA (QC bits 0–1 equal zero); a cell can use day, night, or both channels depending on valid observations.
Earth results are cell centers at approximately 0.05-degree spacing, not station locations or 1-km observations.
